title: Land Raiders
description: An Arizona land-grabber (Telly Savalas) and his brother (George Maharis) renew their feud amid Army troops and Apaches.

title: Daring Danger
description: A wounded cowboy (Tim McCoy) catches rustlers who use a trick branding iron.

title: The Quick Gun
description: A banished gunfighter (Audie Murphy) returns to his sweetheart (Merry Anders) and helps his sheriff friend (James Best) face outlaws.

title: Gunmen From Laredo
description: A framed Texas rancher escapes from prison for a showdown with a saloon keeper.

title: Mackenna's Gold
description: Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.

title: Blazing Across the Pecos
description: The Durango Kid attempts to thwart an outlaw's plot to turn peaceful Indians against neighboring settlers.

title: The Nevadan
description: An undercover U.S. marshal (Randolph Scott) and a crooked rancher follow an outlaw (Forrest Tucker) to stolen gold.

title: Two Rode Together
description: A Texas marshal (James Stewart) and a cavalry officer (Richard Widmark) recover long-held captives from Comanches.

title: Montana Territory
description: A cowgirl vigilante (Wanda Hendrix) proves to a deputy (Lon McCallister) that the sheriff (Preston Foster) is an outlaw.

title: The Return of Daniel Boone
description: The scout's grandson (Bill Elliott) foils land-grabbers; his sidekick (Dub Taylor) flirts with twins.

title: Three Hours to Kill
description: The inhabitants of a small western community turn on Jim Guthrie (Dana Andrews) when he becomes the prime suspect for a murder he didn't commit.

title: Men Without Law
description: Returning from the war, Buck gets caught by Murdock, who takes his letter of introduction to the Del Reys. Posing as Buck, Murdock takes Del Ray's jewels and his daughter Jaunita. To rescue Juanita, Buck poses as Murdock.

title: Renegades
description: The girlfriend (Evelyn Keyes) of a frontier doctor (Willard Parker) falls for a member (Larry Parks) of an outlaw clan.

title: The Great Sioux Massacre
description: The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).

title: Masterson of Kansas
description: Bat Masterson (George Montgomery), Doc Holliday (James Griffith) and Wyatt Earp rescue a framed rancher and stop an Indian war.

title: Massacre Canyon
description: A cavalry officer and two of his men set out to make sure that a shipment of guns safely reaches its destination.

title: Ride Lonesome
description: A bounty hunter's need for vengeance emerges when he learns the outlaw he's escorting is related to his wife's killer.

title: Gunfighters
description: A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) turns cowhand and then back again, fighting a cattle baron with two daughters (Barbara Britton, Dorothy Hart).

title: Oklahoma Crude
description: A wildcatter (Faye Dunaway), her father (John Mills) and a boozing drifter (George C. Scott) defend her oil derrick in 1913 Oklahoma.

title: The Nebraskan
description: War looms on the horizon when an Army officer's American Indian aide is accused of murdering a tribal elder.

title: The Kid From Broken Gun
description: A masked avenger (Charles Starrett) tries to help an innocent man (Jack Mahoney) accused of murder.

title: The Professionals
description: A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit.

title: The Gun That Won the West
description: Superior Springfield rifles help scouts (Dennis Morgan, Richard Denning) and the cavalry get forts built in Wyoming.

title: Blazing the Western Trail
description: A stagecoach operator calls on the Durango Kid when an evil rival attempts to drive him out of business.

title: Rio Grande
description: The conniving Ed Barker murders a rancher and tries to steal the ranch from his widow, Jean Andrews. However, their old friend Cliff Houston appears on the scene to try and save the day.

title: Relentless
description: Framed for a murder he didn't commit, a cowboy hides with a traveling woman as he flees a sheriff and hunts for the real killer.

title: The Last Rebel
description: Two Confederates (Joe Namath, Jack Elam) save a man's (Woody Strode) life and cause trouble in 1865 Missouri.

title: Sierra Stranger
description: Jess Collins, a poor miner, helps Sonny chase off two men he calls claim jumpers. When he arrives in the nearby town, he learns Sonny is no good and everyone in town is against him.

title: Avenging Waters
description: A lone cowboy (Ken Maynard) gets the bad guys and wins the gal (Beth Marion).

title: Gunman's Walk
description: A rugged rancher (Van Heflin) with good and bad sons can only stop his bad son (Tab Hunter) with a gun.

title: The One Way Trail
description: Tim thinks saloon owner Coldeye killed his brother. Seeking the ultimate payback, Tim gets a job in the saloon but has no idea he is targeting the wrong man.

title: Count Three and Pray
description: A preacher (Van Heflin) with a reckless past rebuilds a church after the Civil War with a teenage girl (Joanne Woodward) from the hills.
